content.value: During a month with 30 days, a baseball team plays at least one game a day, but no more than 45 games. Show that there must be a period of same number of consecutive days during which the team must play exactly 14 games.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
